svg.title: The nine kinds of prime-strip in inter-universal Teichmüller theory — docs/DATA_MODEL.md §4

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The nine kinds of prime-strip in inter-universal Teichmüller theory

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A prime-strip is one piece of local data for every valuation v ∈ V of the number field: a Galois group, with or without a monoid of units and values acting under it ([IUTchI] Def 4.1, 5.2 and Fig I1.2; [IUTchII] Def 4.9 adds the ×μ-kinds). The kinds

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: differ only in what they remember — the holomorphic Π_v or just its quotient G_v, the full monoid O▷, the units O× or O×μ, the value groups O▶, the global realified Frobenioid C⊩ — and the whole theory is bookkeeping about which of these

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: survive which link. The toolkit holds all nine as one enum iut_ps_kind, one struct iut_prime_strip with a local datum per v (src/iut.h), one forgetful function iut_prime_strip_forget and one validator iut_validate_prime_strip; this page is drawn from

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: those and from what iut run prints.

svg.text: The nine kinds, and what forgets into what

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Columns: what the strip remembers of the base at v — the holomorphic Π_v, or only the mono-analytic G_v (⊢, ⊩). Rows: how much Frobenius-like structure sits on top — the global realified Frobenioid C⊩ (⊩), a local Frobenioid with

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: value groups, the units alone, or nothing (étale-like). Grey arrows are the forgetful functors of [IUTchI] Def 4.1, 5.2 and Rem 5.2.1; the green ones are the ladder of [IUTchII] Def 4.9 exactly as iut run ForgetLadder walks it; dashed

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: arrows go the other way (a lift, an adjunction). Green frames are the coric kinds of [IUTchIII] Thm 1.5.

svg.text: The other direction exists too: D⊢ ↦ D⊩(D⊢) rebuilds a global realified Frobenioid from the

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: bi-coric core alone ([IUTchII] Cor 4.5 (ii), iut run RealifyFromDMono) — which is why F⊩_Δ can be

svg.text: [IUTchI] Fig I1.2 draws F, F⊢, D, D⊢ and F⊩ as the data of the Θ-Hodge theaters and bridges.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: [IUTchII] Def 4.9 (vi)–(viii) adds F⊢×, F⊢×μ, F⊢▶×μ and F⊩▶×μ: the Θ-link may only identify

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: units modulo torsion and value groups across the alien copies, so it is stated on F⊩▶×μ and

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: induces †F⊢×μ ≅ ‡F⊢×μ (Cor 4.10 (iv)). [IUTchIII] Thm 1.5 then says what each lattice arrow

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: keeps: D and D⊢ vertically, F⊢×μ and D⊢ horizontally — D⊢ is the bi-coric core, and the

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: mono-analytic log-shells I(D⊢) built from it are what the multiradial representation is written in.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: [FormIUT] §1 calls F⊢×μ the basic prime-strip (BasicPrimeStrip): the datum the Θ×μ-links glue.

svg.text: PrimeStrip.WellFormed). A copy id for Π_v, G_v and the monoid; whether the units are O× or O×μ; the value-group portion O▶ with the valuations of its

text.font-family: Inter, 'Inter Display', 'DejaVu Sans', 'Liberation Sans', Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: generators in units of ord(q̲_v); the splitting O▷ = O× × O▶; the Kummer structure; the global portion. Cross-checked against the rungs iut run ForgetLadder
